authority: openarm365_dev_v2.fixture_success.evaluate(env) in native owner only (rule attentionbench-fixture-success-v2: either arm presses, both arms released)

tasks.open_cabinet: Every cabinet door joint is open to at least 0.90 of its range.
tasks.open_drawer: Every drawer door fraction is at least 0.95.
tasks.turn_off_stove: The selected burner knob is outside the inclusive on interval [0.35, 2*pi - 0.35] radians after modulo 2*pi.
tasks.turn_on_microwave: The microwave is on and each physical gripper (left and right) is more than 0.15 m from the start-button geometry origin. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
